risk_summary: The excerpt is relatively transparent and heavily quantified, documenting improved operating income, acquisitions, divestitures, charges, and contingent liabilities. Key risks include cyclical discretionary demand, sourcing and input-cost pressures, inventory markdown exposure, acquisition integration, and material variability in contingent-consideration charges. Overall tone is cautiously optimistic, supported by claimed balance-sheet and liquidity improvements but tempered by ongoing industry and execution risks.
